Hi Bro

welcome here

about trading management ,at first bear in mind that i am not expert ,
but it depends on the situation that i trade , i usually like to trade
the MPL with a tight SL above the zone . and i close some size in the
first obvious target and let PA take me out of the trade or close rest
of the size in LAST FL in the way .

i try to learn to don't risk more than 1 % of my account so that usually
 my sizes are less that 1% because i use less than 0.1 lot per trade
except scalp .

i believe that if we know where to trade (MPL) then there is no need to
be worry about the sizes because always price will bounce in those LVLs.

just trade the extremes then your account will be manage by it self with out any effort

BEST REGARDS

SALIVAN
